title: Battelle Brainstorms injectable interface

tellings.quote: According to Battelle's own 2020 press release, their team progressed to phase two of the program.

plain: A team at the research company Battelle worked on an injectable interface, a device meant to link the brain to machines, and moved on to the second phase of the program that funded it. Michels reports this from Battelle's own press release of 2020, which says its team "progressed to phase two of the program." He tells it in an episode about a UFO book the Pentagon tried to censor, and he connects the work to the Air Force Research Lab and to Carnegie Mellon.
